title: Steps 7–8: the density lower bound at radius ρ bounds the cost of covers of the blow-up at scale 2ρ
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ℓ > 0, A ⊆ ℝ^P, x ∈ ℝ^P and ρ > 0, and let U_j ⊆ ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) be arbitrary sets. Assume (i) every countable cover {C_j}_{j∈ℕ} of A ∩ B_ρ(x) satisfies ρ^ℓ ≤ 2Σ_j (diam C_j)^ℓ; and (ii) every z ∈ ℝ^P with x + 2ρ·z ∈ A and |z| < 1/2 lies in ∪_j U_j. Then Σ_j (diam U_j)^ℓ ≥ 2^{−ℓ}/8. Here |·| is the Euclidean norm, B_ρ(x) = {w ∈ ℝ^P : |w − x| < ρ} is the open ball, diam is the Euclidean diameter with values in [0, ∞] and diam ∅ = 0, sums are in [0, ∞], and 0^ℓ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ℓ → 0 < ρ → (∀ C : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), A ∩ ball x ρ ⊆ ⋃ j, C j → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ ℓ ≤ 2 * ∑' j, Metric.ediam (C j) ^ ℓ) → (∀ z : Euclid P, x + (2 * ρ) • z ∈ A → ‖z‖ < 1 / 2 → z ∈ ⋃ j, U j) → (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-ℓ) / 8 ≤ ∑' j, Metric.ediam (U j) ^ ℓ
